claim.scope: The one named n51 polynomial-01 Boolean presentation in the frozen request
claim.text: An independently checked D5 certificate with codimension greater than a fresh exact solution count proves last fall degree at least 6 for this presentation.

input_selection.rule: Use the published n51 polynomial-01 D4 certificate selected before any n51 D5 closure output. Retain every attempt, refusal, timeout and checker failure.
input_selection.randomization: not applicable to a deterministic exact certificate computation
input_selection.blinding: not applicable; the checker verifies a fixed algebraic identity

controls.positive: The prior native small-system fixture has a frozen D5 certificate hash and passed the original checker through full S3 upload/readback; the EKS-image preflight must also pass before the frontier job is submitted.
controls.negative: Changed input, changed S3 readback, duplicate target, and nonzero producer exit are rejected by transport controls; missing checker acceptance is non-success.
controls.aa: not applicable: no comparative or timed claim
controls.reference: The previously published D4 result, its independent checker transcript and exact count zero are bound by hash; the D5 run rechecks D4 and recounts.

instruments.frozen_by: request instrument hashes plus immutable bundle manifest
instruments.host: isolab EKS x86 CPU Spot, fixed digest-pinned image and 96 GiB pod memory
instruments.memory: 90 GiB producer cap; 96 GiB cgroup admission; source-derived 64,677,063,002-byte native payload envelope is not measured RSS
instruments.input: same n51 polynomial-01 basis, curve coefficients and D4 seed hash as the publication receipt
instruments.nuisance: Spot placement, preemption, AWS transfer throughput and co-tenants are recorded operationally; wall time is invalid for comparison

execution.checkpoint: none for this bounded exporter; preemption censors the attempt and never counts as closure
execution.queue: submit one unique Job only after the image preflight and absence of a live duplicate are checked
execution.durability: assigned ISOLAB_RESULTS_URI; seed and stage receipts uploaded, candidate certificate streamed to S3, full S3 readback hashed while fed to the original checker

measurements.timing: operational L0 only; not a performance endpoint

stopping_rule: One frozen input, one cloud attempt, fixed stage and Job limits. No outcome-dependent substitutions or selective reruns.

decision_rule.lower_bound_6: Require accepted original D5 checker transcript for 1 not in W_5(F), full certificate S3 SHA-256 readback, fresh exact count, and checked codimension > count.
decision_rule.upper_bound: No upper bound or exact LFD inferred from a failed or accepted D5 stage.

analysis.method: Parse the original checker acceptance and exact count, apply the strict inequality, and retain all raw stage receipts. No statistical test or multiple-comparison correction applies to this one exact computation.

literature_boundary: The named-instance lower-bound method does not claim a first empirical refutation of Semaev's degree-four expectation or an asymptotic theorem.
